property: libpcap exposes portable capture/filter semantics and uses filtering based on the BSD Packet Filter architecture while adapting to multiple OS capture mechanisms.

sources.supports: portable capture role and BPF-based filtering statement

negative_claims: libpcap is not identical to a kernel BPF implementation.
The 1993 BPF packet-capture architecture should not be collapsed into all later eBPF systems.
open_questions: Recover first libpcap release and exact transition from earlier tcpdump capture code.
